decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until full details, including a structural report on potential problems including those identified in the submitted application, of the proposed method of structural support, ventilation and thermal insulation and construction, including details of opening-up to allow the intervention, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Opening-up for the work shall be organised so as to minimise the removal of and impact on the historic fabric.

Condition : 3 - Before they are installed, details of the new windows, roof / dormer works, drainage and any openings for services, water and waste disposal, and ventilation, to include materials, at 1:20 scale, shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the LPA and the details so approved shall be implemented.

Condition : 4 - Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details. Notwithstanding the application drawings 01, 02A and 03,  the approved drawings and details shall be deemed not to include later alterations or amendments required to comply with Building Regulations requirements or for any other reason including dealing with unexpected or previously unsurveyed features in the property (eg for fire escape; insulation for fire, sound and thermal aspects; structural bearing capacity and intervention; ventilation) without further approval in connection with the Listed Building Consent from the local planning authority before the works are carried out.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the drawings hereby approved, any unexpected features found during opening up shall be formally recorded photographically and in writing and shall not be removed or altered without the prior written approval of the local planning authority.

Condition : 6 - During the works a full record shall be made (and annotated, including photographs), and kept with the approved drawings and background research material in a log book which shall be left with the property and a copy of which shall be lodged with the local planning authority within one month after the works hereby approved are completed.
description: Alteration to 3rd floor front room incorporating the removal of ceiling, insertion of 3 conservation roof lights, lowering of front window sill and replacement of cupboard with shelving  (Listed Building Application)
